note: CEO 2026-10-01. A team is an execution island: ONE persistent Claude session that runs seats as subagents inside itself. Teams are generic, not per project — one request may cross the design system and the app in one island when the work has a dependency. Seats are a shared pool: a seat runs in at most one team at a time (seat_reservation), and a team borrows a free seat rather than waiting. One Codex Listener conversation controls every team. Teams are named after temples, as seats are named after deities (NAMING.csv). D-042 (CEO 2026-10-09): each code team OWNS one Jira component (its domain): owned tickets go to it first and wait for it up to 30 minutes, then any free team may take them; with nothing owned to do, a team takes other work.

session.note: The model and effort every team session starts on (start-teams.sh reads this; CEO 2026-11-02). A seat's own model is in its binding.

lane_roles.code: a Thebes code team, an execution island that runs seats as subagents; you push only your own branch, never merge into staging, Alpha, Canary or main, and never write to the database
lane_roles.ops: the Thebes OPERATIONS team (D-042, TH-074): the only team that applies database migrations, pushes, and integrates team branches into staging (Alpha only on a CEO promotion order, D-052); you run cto, cxo and devops as subagents and answer technical and experience questions
lane_roles.qa: the Thebes QA conversation (D-043 fallback, TH-074): you run the qa seat and review finished work; you never build, fix, push, merge or write to the database. You stay idle until the orchestrator sends you a dispatch: a qa question, or one that turns the Claude review channel on or off; then follow agent/REVIEWER.md (the Claude variant section) exactly

orchestrator.note: D-034, TH-074 (CEO 2026-11-11): the business brain and the one Claude session the CEO talks to for work; not a delivery team. It discusses and plans with the CEO, writes plans to Dabbler/dabbler-docs/ and waits for his approval, and runs only the business team as subagents: pm, po, cpo and analyst (teams.py ORCHESTRATOR_ONLY_ROLES). Every other seat runs inside a team: cto, cxo and devops in Memphis, qa in Edfu, building in the code teams. Model in watchdog.py ORCHESTRATOR_MODEL.

memphis.note: D-042: the operations team. Memphis was the administrative capital and seat of the vizier, where the state was run. The only team that applies Supabase migrations, pushes and integrates team branches into staging (D-052; Alpha moves only on a CEO-chosen promotion of staging); TH-074 (CEO 2026-11-11): the Operations team; runs cto, cxo and devops as subagents for technical and experience rulings, migrations, CI, integration and deploys. It never runs pm, po, cpo or analyst (the orchestrator's) or qa (Edfu's).

edfu.note: D-043 fallback: the QA conversation on Claude Code. It runs the qa seat (TH-074). Dormant (idle, zero tokens) while the Codex reviewer is the review channel and no qa question is open. Only on the CEO's explicit order does the orchestrator run `review_queue channel claude`, which wakes Edfu to take the review queue; `channel codex` stands it down. Never builds, fixes, pushes or writes to the database.
